_comment: Stage 1 agronomic priors (capsicum/bell pepper, greenhouse). Sources: README_CAPSICUM.md. Several fields disagree between sources (noted there) or are estimates where no figure matched CropFit's exact capacitive/DLI scale -- see confidence notes before using in production without field validation.

soil_moisture._comment: Capacitive sensor %, calibrated 0 = bone dry, 100 = saturated. Estimate: nudged higher than tomato given Gramillo-Avila et al. 2024 found ~81.5% FC already cut yield 24-52% -- needs field calibration, source used a different (weight-based) moisture scale.

light._comment: dli_min_mj is an approximate conversion from mol/m2/day PAR figures (22.6-39.6 mol/m2/day, Adame-Adame et al. 2025) -- confidence LOW, verify against your sensor's calibration.

actuator_rates._comment: Unchanged from the tomato profile -- these describe fan/heater/mister hardware, not the crop.
